title: Global patterns and drivers of bee richness and endemism on islands
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11325-6

Gobal analysis of bee species across 305 islands reveals that islands account for 20% of global bee diversity, with more than 4,100 species and high levels of endemism, and shows that richness is shaped by island size, isolation and evolutionary diversification.
